{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Sort by revenue in descending order
revenue_by_channel_sorted = revenue_by_channel.sort_values('revenue_numeric', ascending=False)

# Extract the top channel
best_channel_row = revenue_by_channel_sorted.iloc[0]

# Print only the required evidence
print(f"Total revenue for 'email': {best_channel_row['revenue_numeric']:.2f}")
print(f"Total revenue for 'paid_search': {revenue_by_channel_sorted.iloc[1]['revenue_numeric']:.2f}")

# Return the best channel name
best_channel_row['channel']"}
